user.title: Pick a remote
user.description: Choose any device that has button (event) entities, e.g. an IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel, Hue dimmer or Matter switch. After adding it, open **Remote Mapper** in the sidebar, tap the pencil, press a button and choose what it should do.

error.no_event_entities: This device has no enabled event (button) entities.

abort.already_configured: This remote is already set up.

data.edit_timeout: Edit mode turns itself off after

data_description.profile: Automatic picks a dedicated layout when one exists for this model. Changing it clears mappings that do not exist in the new layout.
data_description.edit_timeout: Seconds of inactivity before edit mode switches off and the remote works normally again.
